messages:
Priya (Marketing): Quick: need a slim battlecard by Thurs for webinar. Focus: 1) benchmark headline vs managed cloud endpoints 2) 3 SDR snips 3) 2 procurement rebut bullets.

Jordan (Product): Keep claims tight: unified runtime (hosted/ded/private), cost levers (batching + KV cache), graceful fallbacks. Call out SDK streaming.

Mateo (Eng-ML): Bench highlights: redwood-v1 (quant) vs CloudX-managed on seq128 chat -> ~25-35ms p95 win and ~20-30% lower effective cost_per_1k after batching. CSV link coming.

Sam (Sales): SDR snips drafts (short):
- Cost: "Reduce per-token spend with smart batching and cache."
- Latency: "Predictable p95s engineered for production SLAs."
- Security: "Private control plane + KMS for compliant deploys."

Ava (Field): Procurement rebut bullets:
1) "Managed endpoints = easy; Redwood = serving runtime + private VPC, KMS, rollout controls for governance."
2) "We expose levers (batching, cache, quant profiles) so teams can tune unit economics, not guess."

Lila (Growth): Webinar headline tests: A) "Predictable inference, predictable costs." B) "Ship LLM features without surprise bills." I'll A/B both.

Priya (Marketing): Perfect. Jordan add fallback/demo blurb to battlecard, Mateo paste final bench, Lila run AB, Sam finalize SDR playbook. ops-bot: reminder set for battlecard draft due 2026-07-12 16:00 UTC.

Jordan (Product): Will add a 3-step failover flow (region -> quantized model -> degraded-cache mode) and note how it maps to uptime/latency SLOs.

Priya (Marketing): Thanks team ":teamwork:" Ill stitch and share EOD Thursday. Ping me if blocked.
